Title: Delete an image with a missing object name
Steps:
1. Send a DELETE request to /api/images/{objectName} with an empty objectName.

Test Data: {"objectName": ""}
Expected Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with an error message indicating that the 'objectName' parameter is required.

Title: Delete an image with a non-existent object name
Steps:
1. Send a DELETE request to /api/images/{objectName} with a non-existent objectName.

Test Data: {"objectName": "non-existent-object"}
Expected Result: HTTP 404 Not Found status code with an error message indicating that the specified object does not exist.

Title: Delete an image with an invalid object name format
Steps:
1. Send a DELETE request to /api/images/{objectName} with an objectName containing invalid characters.

Test Data: {"objectName": "invalid-object-name"}
Expected Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with an error message indicating that the 'objectName' parameter has an invalid format.

Title: Create an order with a missing customer photo
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/orders with a request body containing a missing customer photo.

Test Data: {"customerPhoto": null}
Expected Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with an error message indicating that the 'customerPhoto' field is required.

Title: Create an order with an invalid customer photo format
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/orders with a request body containing an invalid customer photo format.

Test Data: {"customerPhoto": "invalid-base64-string"}
Expected Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with an error message indicating that the 'customerPhoto' field contains an invalid base64 string.
